title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium on 1973-06-10
source: Partial Sets 1 & 2; source: aud cassette master; taped by Jimmy & Laurie Cooper, & Arti; Arti’s akg mics > hitachi trq-222; maxell ud-c90; nakamichi dragon > benchmark adc1 24/96 > mac > adobe audition cc > fission > xACT flac; power by furman p-2400IT; transfer & mastering - Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Stunningly clear capture of a ’73 show with exceptional performance and top‑tier sound quality
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves that this is the most vivid ‘73 Dead recording they’ve ever heard, urging playback on high‑end gear to fully appreciate its jaw‑dropping clarity. Both the musical performance and the audio fidelity are described as essential, indicating a show of high energy paired with an excellent recording.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises both performance and sound quality; weighting favors the strong musical impression, but limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as unlike any other ’73 capture; extremely clear and detailed, best experienced on high‑end speakers or headphones. No specific issues noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific setlist comments provided; reviewer emphasizes overall performance quality.
